QuestInfo.name: The Ruler Is Out
QuestInfo.0: The elves don't seem to understand what happened. Explain the situation to Philius and tell him about the impostor.
QuestInfo.1: Philius thanked you for saving the elves, and will let you know if he hears anything about Mercedes or her impostor.
QuestInfo.2: Philius promised to contact you once Mercedes returns. He wishes he could have been a better host, and promises to make you feel more welcome next time. You left Elluel, hoping that there will be a next time.

0.0: Then that means we were lost in a dream someone else created. We are elves, supposed seers of truth. I am terribly ashamed, doubly so upon hearing of this vile impostor.
0.1: I discovered a letter from Athena Pierce, saying you are a friend of our ruler? I am afraid she is still traveling to regain her powers. I can't say when Mercedes will return, but I will contact you the moment she does.

yes.0: Our ruler will be quite happy that her old friend is here. Mercedes is very warm-hearted, as I'm sure you already know.

no.0: Ah, then would you like to wait for our queen here? A guest of Mercedes is a guest of ours. Please, make yourself at home.

1.0: Please visit Elluel again soon. I apologize for being a poor host, incapaciatated as I was. Next time I hope to greet you better.

yes.0: Thank you again for your help. We will also tell Mercedes about your work.
